'''''Star Wars: Purge – The Tyrant's Fist''''' is the fourth story arc of the [[Purge (comic book)|''Purge'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series. It was written by [[Alexander Freed]] and the first issue was published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[December 5]], [[2012]]. Contrary to the other ''Purge'' story arcs, ''The Tyrant's Fist'' was a two-part story. It covered the adventures of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] during the [[Vaklin insurgency]].
